scope: Theorem 4.1 (Nilpotent detection) of the manuscript “Constructible tame Hecke eigensheaves in positive characteristic” (preprints/Constructible-tame-Hecke-eigensheaves-in-positive-characteristic-October-5-2026/constructible-tame-hecke-eigensheaves-positive-characteristic.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 014 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 73db2ee4a6d9f8ad), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 15. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let B be such a bundle stack over an algebraically closed field, and let F be a locally bounded constructible E-complex on B. Suppose that, for every spherical Satake representation V and each curve on which modifications are allowed, there is an isomorphism HV (F) ≃ F ⊠ VV with VV lisse on the open curve. Then SS(b∗F) ⊂ ΛD for every smooth finite-type scheme chart b : D → B.
